additional_info.subject: Sicharge D - 170000993 | CHADEMO Out of Order
additional_info.body:
Dear supporter,
We are having issues with Chademo.
In the same station we have 2 chargers. Last time they customer attemped charging one Nissan Leaf with both chargers.
170000993 | Error while charging
170000997 | Charging was OK
On the 170000993 we can see errors like these in the logs
ERR_EXTVOLT, External Voltage is wrong (either too high \u003e10V during CPD or below 50V battery voltage)
Some charging sessions were attempted on Wednesday 10
th
between 16:30 UTC and 17:45 UTC.
There also were some texts mentioning Welding Detection or similar.
We are aware that currently we are having the following error flags, but shouldn’t the charger be able to charge with less Converters?
Could you please help us understand if we need to replace the converters or else, the charger should still work with less converters?
Best regards
Mariano Galizia Alfano
Siemens

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0368752-DC/Si-D/AR-[MP / P9 170000993] CHAdeMO Out of Order CRM:00921000972
additional_info.body:
HI Mariano,
I hope this email finds you well.
Thanks for sharing the update over Notes, but I recommend you mention this information in the email for future practice. However, I can see in the email below that Beerpal has discussed with you and reduced the count of converters in DC outlet 1 to a maximum power of 40kW. As I checked the configuration of the charger, it is a low flex of 160kW, and I changed the converter grouping accordingly. We still have a CAN communication loss error on a couple of converters. Please arrange a site intervention along with spare converters to run the charger at full capacity if it's not a wiring issue. I'll hand over the ticket to your queue for on-site troubleshooting and to replace the converters if needed.
